summary: A striker tells the council what lost health insurance did to a family member.
realLife: A hospital worker told a council that losing her health insurance left her uninsured son unable to get care when he was hospitalized; she was personal and pointed at the hospital.
sources: West Virginia Public Broadcasting, striking workers urge Huntington City Council: https://wvpublic.org/story/government/striking-workers-urge-huntington-city-council-to-support-blocked-resolution/amp/
inGame: a protest or strike with officials at the edge; a relative tie; needs: health insurance records

turns.summary: The striker cites pay cuts and dollars only.
A council member tears up in reply.
